name: LD6002B 3D Presence Radar
description: The `ld6002b` component allows you to use the Hi-Link HLK-LD6002B 60 GHz 3D presence radar module with ESPHome. It can track up to 3 people and reports per-target position (X/Y/Z), cluster ID, and Doppler index.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) to use. Required if you have multiple UARTs configured.

config_entries.label: Wakeup Pin
config_entries.description: Pin used to wake the radar from low power mode. Required if you want `auto_wake` or the `wake` button to function. With `low_power` enabled and no `wakeup_pin` wired, the first command after an idle period is consumed as a wake-up and is retried automatically; wiring `wakeup_pin` avoids that retry.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component.

config_entries.label: Wakeup Pulse
config_entries.description: Pulse length for the wakeup pin. **Requires** `wakeup_pin`.
